ShapeEngine
Table of Contents

Struct Line

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.LineDef
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an infinite line in 2D space, defined by a point on the line and a direction vector. Includes methods for geometric operations such as intersections, overlaps, and closest point calculations.

public readonly struct Line

Returns

GetClosestPointLineCircle(Vector2, Vector2, Vector2, float, out float)

Calculates the closest points between an infinite line and a circle in 2D space.

public static (Vector2 self, Vector2 other) GetClosestPointLineCircle(Vector2 linePoint, Vector2 lineDirection, Vector2 circleCenter, float circleRadius, out float disSquared)

Parameters

linePoint Vector2

A point on the line.

lineDirection Vector2

The direction vector of the line.

circleCenter Vector2

The center of the circle.

circleRadius float

The radius of the circle.

disSquared float

Outputs the squared distance between the closest points on the line and the circle.

Returns

(Vector2 self, Vector2 other)

A tuple containing the closest point on the line and the closest point on the circle, respectively.

Remarks

The closest point on the circle is found by projecting the closest point on the line onto the circle's perimeter. The squared distance is clamped to zero to avoid negative values due to floating point errors.

GetClosestPointLineLine(Vector2, Vector2, Vector2, Vector2, out float)

Calculates the closest points between two infinite lines in 2D space.

public static (Vector2 self, Vector2 other) GetClosestPointLineLine(Vector2 line1Point, Vector2 line1Direction, Vector2 line2Point, Vector2 line2Direction, out float disSquared)

Parameters

line1Point Vector2

A point on the first line.

line1Direction Vector2

The direction vector of the first line.

line2Point Vector2

A point on the second line.

line2Direction Vector2

The direction vector of the second line.

disSquared float

Outputs the squared distance between the closest points on the two lines. Returns 0 if the lines intersect, -1 if they are parallel.

Returns

(Vector2 self, Vector2 other)

A tuple containing the closest points on each line, respectively.

Remarks

If the lines intersect, the returned points are identical and disSquared is 0. If the lines are parallel, the original points are returned and disSquared is -1.
